concept: an ape walking on four legs and on two
idea: An ape walks on all fours, leaning on its knuckles, but its skeleton also lets it stand: its body tips up until it balances over its hips, and its arms hang free.

parameters.name: posture
parameters.why: The two ways its skeleton lets it move.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.why: From standing still to a quick walk or run.

moves: The ape walks on the spot over a ground that slides under it; changing its posture tips its body up onto its legs or down onto its knuckles over about a second.
steps: On all fours, the long arms take weight on the knuckles
Standing up, the body tips until it balances over the hips
On two legs the arms hang free and swing
Its legs are short for its body, so it stands with bent knees
